MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Notte Magica feels like a natural next choice because its tenor tribute connects with the expressive ensemble singing I enjoy in Amor & Pasion and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "Simon & Garfunkel and The Righteous Brothers appeal through gentle harmonies and expressive romantic singing, while Best Of Rachmaninoff connects with my latest interest in relaxing classical listening."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Christmas vocal albums connect with past listening, but I am not looking for seasonal music right now, so that connection alone does not make me want to choose them.",
    "PTX, Vol. 1 and The Book of Mormon do not fit my current wish for orchestral music or expressive traditional vocals; enjoying harmonies or Stages does not mean every vocal group or musical suits this session.",
    "Original Album Classics and 21 Number Ones leave me unsure of the performer and repertoire, so I cannot identify a musical reason to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing interest rather than something I might want only at particular times.",
    "My interest in vocal ensembles and stage songs seems to have been stretched into a broader interest in vocal releases and musicals than my choices support."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest classical listening makes a relaxed mood more relevant to me now, even when an older interest points toward something livelier or comic.",
    "The kind of singing matters: expressive tenor voices, romantic delivery, and orchestral accompaniment draw me more than the presence of harmonies alone.",
    "Knowing the artist and pieces matters to my decision; a broad collection title does not give me enough evidence that I will enjoy the music."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my taste for melodic vocals and classical music, but give too much weight to older seasonal and theatrical interests when I want relaxed, expressive listening now."
}
